levels.surface: إسماعيل بن علي بن رزين ابن أخي دعبل بن علي الخزاعي

notes: Each «أبي» before a name is one link with the name alone (rule 7); the first «أبيه» is a relation with no name; «المجاور في مسجد الكوفة» is a description and «الإمام» a title, both left out; the chain closes at Abu Talib, who relays the Prophet's words.

fixes.reason: The Arabic says the fourth link is the son of the brother of Di'bil, while the English calls him the brother of Di'bil.
